text: Cooked Meat recipe says '45 energy (raw: 25)' but there is no Eat key on any of the 3 Controls pages and no Eat button in Inventory (I). Energy seems to rise on its own (84->99 after first chop while apples went 2->1; 90.6->99 around chicken harvest), so food appears to be auto-eaten, but nothing on screen says so. Player cannot choose to eat cooked over raw meat.

Objective 1 'Gather wood 10' counts wood currently held, so crafting sets it back: it read Wood 9/10 at tick ~760 (after 13 wood gathered), dropped to 6 then 5/10 after crafting a pickaxe and cooked meat. After crafting a second pickaxe (wood 5->2) the HUD still says Wood 5/10 while Inventory shows Wood: 2 - the bar neither tracks held wood nor total gathered. Expected: gathering progress that crafting does not undo.

Expanding the Era box (tap) pushes the Objective panel down and the Inventory Info panel slides right to x~220, where it sits under the Tip 4 card; the two overlap. Also Village era needs Day 3 (plus 10 members, 2 stalls), so Planks and Bricks (Workshop) are unreachable in a short session: at observed 8-12 tps a game day is ~45 real minutes.
